parameters.name: --name
parameters.help: Name of the Azure SQL Server. You can configure the default using `az configure --defaults sql-server=<name>`.

parameters.name: --resource-group
parameters.help: Name of resource group. You can configure the default group using `az configure --defaults group=<name>`.

parameters.name: --admin-password
parameters.help: The administrator login password (required forserver creation).

parameters.name: --admin-user
parameters.help: Administrator username for the server. Oncecreated it cannot be changed.

parameters.name: --assign-identity
parameters.help: Generate and assign an Azure Active Directory Identity for this server for use with key management services like Azure KeyVault.

parameters.name: --enable-ad-only-auth
parameters.help: Enable Azure Active Directory Only Authentication for this server.

parameters.name: --enable-public-network
parameters.help: Set whether public network access to server is allowed or not. When false,only connections made through Private Links can reach this server. WARNING: Argument '--enable-public-network' is in preview and under development. Reference and support levels: https://aka.ms/CLI_refstatus

parameters.name: --external-admin-name
parameters.help: Display name of the Azure AD administrator user, group or application.

parameters.name: --external-admin-principal-type
parameters.help: User, Group or Application.

parameters.name: --external-admin-sid
parameters.help: The unique ID of the Azure AD administrator. Object Id for User or Group, Client Id for Applications.

parameters.name: --federated-client-id
parameters.help: The federated client id used in cross tenant CMK scenario.

parameters.name: --identity-type
parameters.help: Type of Identity to be used. Possible values are SystemAsssigned,UserAssigned, SystemAssigned,UserAssigned and None.

parameters.name: --key-id
parameters.help: The key vault URI for encryption.

parameters.name: --location
parameters.help: Location. You can configure the default location using `az configure --defaults location=<location>`.

parameters.name: --minimal-tls-version
parameters.help: The minimal TLS version enforced by the sql server for inbound connections.

parameters.name: --no-wait
parameters.help: Do not wait for the long-running operation to finish.

parameters.name: --pid
parameters.help: The ID of the primary user managed identity.

parameters.name: --restrict-outbound-network-access
parameters.help: Set whether outbound network access to server is restricted or not. When true,the outbound connections from the server will be restricted. WARNING: Argument '--restrict-outbound-network-access' is in preview and under development. Reference and support levels: https://aka.ms/CLI_refstatus

parameters.name: --sdrd
parameters.help: Specify the number of days to retain soft deleted server (0-7). Set to 0 to disable soft delete. Set to 1-7 days to enable soft delete with the specified retention period. During the retention period, the server can be restored using az sql server restore. WARNING: Argument '--soft-delete-retention-days' is in preview and under development. Reference and support levels: https://aka.ms/CLI_refstatus

parameters.name: --tags
parameters.help: Space-separated tags: key[=value] [key[=value]...]. Use '' to clear existing tags.

parameters.name: --user-assigned-identity-id
parameters.help: Generate and assign an User Managed Identity(UMI) for this server.

parameters.name: --acquire-policy-token
parameters.help: Acquiring an Azure Policy token automatically for this resource operation.

parameters.name: --change-reference
parameters.help: The related change reference ID for this resource operation.

parameters.name: --debug
parameters.help: Increase logging verbosity to show all debug logs.

parameters.name: --help
parameters.help: Show this help message and exit.

parameters.name: --only-show-errors
parameters.help: Only show errors, suppressing warnings.

parameters.name: --output
parameters.help: Output format.

parameters.name: --query
parameters.help: JMESPath query string. See http://jmespath.org/ for more information and examples.

parameters.name: --subscription
parameters.help: Name or ID of subscription. You can configure the default subscription using `az account set -s NAME_OR_ID`.

parameters.name: --verbose
parameters.help: Increase logging verbosity. Use --debug for full debug logs.
